verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a Registrar API reference covering searching, checking, registering, and managing domains, and publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec that tooling could use to build interactive exploration. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive or offers runnable examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API reference experience.
